title: Chapter 6215: Are You Just Pretending?

Chapter 6215: Are You Just Pretending?

Chapter 6215: Are You Just Pretending?

Li Qiye patted the monarch's shoulder and said: "Must I be troubled by this little formation?"

"..." The four young saints had no response.

"Little formation? This was created by Progenitor Xuansu." Orchidcore stared at Li Qiye. Calling it a supreme formation was not out of line in any era.

"Yes." On the other hand, the monarch nodded repeatedly and said: "A little formation indeed for you, Young Noble. Just one wave is enough, so please take care of it."

The four didn't understand why the arrogant monarch wanted to please Li Qiye.

"Not worth my effort, you do it." Li Qiye shook his head.

"I..." The monarch pointed at his nose and shook his head: "I can't, hehe, I don't have the ability to do so."

"What, you are a genius who created a supreme witchcraft art. This little formation can't trouble you." Li Qiye said.

"Right, you did say that your art was far superior to Desolate Ancestor's immortal dao. I can't imagine this little formation will be a challenge." Princess Chen laughed.

"Bah, I never said that, don't put words into my mouth." The monarch denied.

"Guys, did he say it yesterday?" She smiled.

"He did." The other three spoke in unison.

"Witch Monarch, I also heard it." Li Xian said.

"Delusional, all of you." The monarch had thick skin and didn't admit his boast.

"Well, let's drop whether you said it or not. The important thing is, do you see your witchcraft as unique?" The princess asked.

"Of course, it is one and only, completely separated from the dao system created by the three immortals and the cultivation system started by Desolate Ancestor. Never seen before, never repeated again, my feat." He said proudly.

"Wouldn't such a great art be able to dispel this little formation?" The princess asked.

"Obviously!" The monarch said.

"Hahaha, then go ahead." The princess said.

"Child, you dare play these games with me?" The monarch glanced at the fog.

"We are just confident in your ability." She said.

"Yes." The others nodded.

"I know you can do it, Monarch." Li Xian said sincerely.

"Aiya!" The monarch suddenly grabbed his stomach and looked to be in pain: "Crap, I must have eaten something bad, I have to go now!"

His action shocked the crowd due to how childish and shameless it was. Alas, Li Qiye stopped him again.

"Young Noble, I have to go to the restroom now..." The monarch begged.

"Either wait or just go in your pants." Li Qiye said slowly.

The others wanted to laugh after hearing this.

"This is too cruel..." The monarch's complexion turned purple, making them wonder if he was faking it.

"So, you or me?" Li Qiye asked.

"I'll do it, I'll do it." The monarch realized the futility of the situation and patted his stomach: "Wow, I suddenly feel better now."

He stood up straight and gestured confidently at the group: "Now, I will show you all my peerless witchcraft by taking down this formation."

"You can really do it?" The princess was a skeptic.

Others didn't know if he was only boasting or could actually do it.

"There isn't a single formation in this world that I can't break. It's a matter of whether I want to or not." He declared.

"Any of them?" Li Xian asked earnestly.

"Obviously, I am someone who can start a new epoch with my witchcraft. My feat has no equal, so this formation isn't on my level, no formation is." The monarch said.

"I can't believe you haven't bitten your tongue yet with so much boasting." Princess Chen said.

"What about Life and Death Formation?" Mu Hu asked.

"Shut up, are you really an idiot or just pretending?" The monarch glared at him.

"It's not a bad question." Princess Chen asked: "You said yourself no formation can endure as long as you wish to break it. I'm sure Life and Death Formation is not an exception."

"Well, life comes from death in that formation and I have no intention of dying, so I won't even try." The monarch said.

With that, he arched his chest and said: "Well, you're too young to know that there are things one should and shouldn't do. Watch, I will break this formation now."

Li Xian started trusting him after seeing his confidence.

"Yes, do it and we will have nothing but respect for your ability." Princess Chen smiled.

"Don't break your jaw by letting it drop to the ground then." The monarch said.

"Hurry up already." Li Qiye chuckled.
